lines.text: Where you dey go? [Where are you going?]
Keke! Keke! Gate, Senate, New Site!
Shuttle to New Site! One more! One more! Two more!
Na gode! [Thank you!] Safe journey!
Ah! Watch your leg! The keke is not a footstool!
Rain! Fare has doubled! Don't look at me, look at the sky!
Senate one-fifty! Mall two hundred! Far places, negotiate!
Enter, enter. There is space. Space is a mindset.
Shift small. Small. Small again. Perfect. Now we are four.
Oga, your change is coming. It's on the next trip.
Everybody bring exact. Change is on strike.
Hold well. This road has opinions.
Pothole there! Pothole here! The pothole is the road.
Last shuttle to New Site! After this one, it's your legs.
Fuel went up again. So did I. Two-fifty now.
Where is my conductor? He went to buy bread one hour ago.
Night price is different. Darkness is a premium service.
Ghost okada at three in the morning? Abeg [please], I'm going home.
I don't pass by the garden at night. Not fear. Just… sleep.
Traffic lights are off again. Me, I'm the traffic light now.
One fresher asked me for a receipt. Receipt! For keke!
I carried a goat yesterday. Better passenger than you. Didn't argue.
Mall! Mall! Everybody's going to look at the escalator!
Fuel queue from here to tomorrow. Fare is now 'how much you get?'
Okada school? Who taught that one? He's riding like an apology.
The strike has finished my customers. I carry bread and memories.
Empty campus. I'm riding slowly so it looks busy.
Motor park is full. Everybody's going home till they call it off.
Every passenger is filming. Am I trending? Tell me if I'm trending.
Campaign sticker in front, another one at the back. I'm neutral.
Candidates giving free rides. My income has resigned.
Finalists everywhere! Hold your gown, the wind is fast!
Five years I carry you, now you're going? Pay double. For memory.
Freshers! Senate this way! Hostel that way! Future: pay me.
Exam hall? Hold tight. I'll fly you. Safely.
Results day. Half my passengers are singing, half are silent.
Allowance day. First the bank, then the mall, then back to me.
Gidan Kwari! Thursday market! Shift small!
Kaduna! Kano! Jos! Home is calling, I'm the phone!
Stadium! Stadium! Match at four! Wear your colours!
A candidate put a speaker on my keke. My ears are on strike.
Convocation! Families, big bags! Canopy! Canopy this way!
Last trips before iftar! Hurry, hurry, sunset doesn't wait!
Christmas travellers! Bags on top, people inside, chickens… we'll see.
Harmattan dust. I can't see the road. The road can't see me. Fair.
